name: @veren/crawler-skill
description: Use when a DSH profile installs the crawler stack and agents must know when and how to drive the content crawler: it contributes one bundled, model-invocable skill named crawler that explains when collecting public content is the right request, the six crawler__ tools (start/stop/status/logs/data/wordcloud), the single-task mutex, the host-storage-domain medium, the login requirement (guest sessions cover wb/tieba search and creator), and failure handling; skip it when the crawler stack is absent or agents never collect content.
